title: EXP-080-R2 - Hello World Part 5 Section 3: Add the Derived Property FX_DerOrderTotal to the FX_Orders IDO (replay with a Tab-committed Property Name)
objective: Replay of EXP-080, which was blocked when the Derived wizard raised "Value is required for Property Name" after a plain fill without a Tab commit. Follow hello-world-pt5.md Section 3 (03:33-05:05), adapted to FX_ names. In the Web Client IDO Collections runtime Form (titled IDOs), retrieve exactly the IDO FX_Orders (checked out to the operator; tables fxcus, fxitms and fxords; 16 properties after EXP-079) and record its identity, checkout state, Tables view and complete property inventory. Run the New Property wizard once, choose Derived instead of Bound on the first page, name the property FX_DerOrderTotal (the tutorial's Der-prefixed order total), select the existing property class FX_Cost, and enter the derived expression FX_Count * FX_ItmsCost (the tutorial's "count * itms cost", using the saved FX_Orders property names). Finish once. Close and reopen IDO Collections once and verify the inventory equals the baseline plus FX_DerOrderTotal, Derived, with its class and expression. The tutorial's Label String ID override and Read Only setting are EXP-081; its unload is deferred. FX_Orders stays checked out. Findings are observed only.

Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If it expires, follow the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure once and end the task. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection. Do not touch the Web Designer tab.

Disposition of the EXP-080 leftovers (first browser step after the tab list and one snapshot): if a Session Expired modal is shown, follow the session-expiry procedure once (the open Forms are then gone). Otherwise, if the IDO Property Wizard tab still shows the prompt "Value is required for Property Name / Do you want to change the value now?", click Yes once (it only returns focus to the field), then click the wizard Cancel once and record any response; nothing is committed before Finish (EXP-061, EXP-080). If Cancel raises another prompt, record its exact text and stop.

Session warning: if the yellow strip "Your session is about to expire" is visible before the New Property wizard is opened and no Form is dirty, run the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure once proactively (it counts as the task's one re-login); afterwards reopen the IDOs Form once through Select Form and re-run the visible-criterion FX_Orders query once (one extra target query is authorized for this case).

Fresh IDOs Form: if the IDOs tab is open and clean, close it once through its Form-tab control and reopen it once through Form > Open > Select Form. Check the status bar for Filter in Place before clicking it.

Target and baseline: in Filter in Place, type FX_Orders into the IDO Name criterion, commit with Tab, capture the criterion before F4, press F4 once and establish exactly one FX_Orders row checked out to the operator. Record Revision and Locked By; the Tables view (expected FX_HelloWorld01 fxcus, FX_Items fxitms, FX_Orders fxords); and the complete property inventory (expected 16, including FX_Count and FX_ItmsCost). Prove FX_DerOrderTotal and any other Derived property absent.
Checkout gate: proceed only if FX_Orders is checked out to the operator. This experiment contains no checkout-management action at all; if it is checked in, locked by another user or ambiguous, stop.

Derived wizard: open the New Property wizard once. On the first page choose Derived once (click its visible label if the radio click does not take) and click Next once; record page 2 before entry. Property Name: click into the field, type FX_DerOrderTotal with keystrokes (browser_type with slowly true, not a programmatic fill) and press Tab once; verify the readback FX_DerOrderTotal and that no prompt appeared, before touching any other field. Property Class: open the lookup once and select FX_Cost once; record the readback and every Inherit from Property Class box with the shown types (expected Decimal, Length 18, Decimal 2, decimal). Expression: if its Inherit from Property Class box is ticked and the box is disabled, untick that one box once and record the result; click into the expression box, type FX_Count * FX_ItmsCost with keystrokes and commit by clicking once on the empty Property Attributes area of the page (not Tab, not Enter); record the readback verbatim. Leave the Data Type and Column Data Type inherit boxes as the class sets them. Capture the configured page, then Finish once and record the response verbatim.

Stop rule inside the wizard: at any stop before Finish (unexpected type, class, readback, validation message or prompt), record the exact state and text, answer a "change the value now" prompt with Yes once if one is open, and click the wizard Cancel once so no open wizard or prompt is left behind; never Finish after a stop.

After the Finish, perform at most one ordinary Save only if the Form was left dirty. Verify exactly one added property FX_DerOrderTotal with its property type (Derived), class, sequence, expression (where the grid or detail shows it) and Read Only state, and the 16 baseline properties unchanged; verify FX_Orders is checked out to the operator.

Close the clean IDOs Form once more and reopen it once more (the recovery pair); run one fresh visible-criterion FX_Orders query and compare the recovered property inventory, the FX_DerOrderTotal details and the checkout state with the baseline plus the one property.

Capture screenshots of the disposition result, the pre-F4 criteria, the baseline inventory, each wizard page before filling, the configured wizard before Finish, the post-Finish inventory and the recovered inventory and details.
Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. Classify findings as observed only.
